column5: in extra, so no installer to pipe into sh. NB: do NOT `pnpm self-update` a pacman-installed pnpm - same trap as `sudo npm -g`, it writes over files pacman owns and the next -Syu fights it. Globals still land in $PNPM_HOME/bin (~/.local/share/pnpm/bin), which dot_zshrc puts on PATH
in extra; the old "-" and "source-built SDK" note were stale
pinned, not the rolling dotnet-sdk meta
aliased as `lzd` in dot_zshrc; in extra, not the AUR; needs >=0.24.2 - older builds pin Docker API v1.25 and draw empty panels on Docker >=25

SERVER, not just the client - Arch splits this differently from Fedora and the old note here was a straight carry-over of the Fedora meaning. On Fedora `postgresql` is the client and `postgresql-server` is the daemon; on Arch `postgresql` IS the daemon (70 MB) and it depends on postgresql-libs (11 MB), which is the client + libpq. So there is no postgresql-server to add: this one row already gives you both. Needs initdb before first start - see SETUP-GUIDE Phase 5, and NOT Fedora's postgresql-setup
AUR-only, and it is the primary editor

NOT a package on purpose. `zed` IS in extra, but the channel actually run here is PREVIEW, which the repos do not carry (the AUR zed-preview-bin lags and does not self-update). Upstream's installer is the supported path for preview and updates in-app: curl -fsSL https://zed.dev/install.sh | ZED_CHANNEL=preview sh -> ~/.local/zed-preview.app. NB: the variable belongs on the RIGHT of the pipe - prefixing curl scopes it to curl and the installer defaults to stable. bootstrap.sh handles the '-'

Antigravity 2.0 - the multi-agent ORCHESTRATION PLATFORM (antigravity.google/product/antigravity-2), which is NOT the IDE. The note here used to call it "the IDE app" and describe antigravity-ide as merely an older 2.5.x build of the same thing; both were wrong. antigravity-ide is a SEPARATE Google product - the agentic IDE - and it has 5x the AUR votes, so it is the one you land on by searching and the mistake is easy to repeat. Do not "upgrade" this row to it. antigravity-appimage carries the IDE's description on a 2.11.0 version string and is a FUSE build; avoid it too
Antigravity's CLI companion; the binary is `agy`, not `antigravity`

NOT the AUR package on purpose. Anthropic's own installer (curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash) is the supported path on Arch - the docs point non-Debian distros at it - and it SELF-UPDATES into ~/.local/share/claude/versions/<ver> with a ~/.local/bin/claude symlink. The AUR build would pin a version paru has to chase. bootstrap.sh handles the '-'
OpenAI Codex CLI. In extra, so do NOT switch this to the AUR openai-codex-bin

pencil.dev, the design-on-canvas -> code tool. Two AUR packages wrap the same official download: pencil-dev-bin (tarball) pins 1.1.56 against an UNVERSIONED url, so its sha256 no longer matches what pencil.dev serves and it fails to build. pencil-dev-appimage is current (1.2.0) AND installs the bundled MCP server to a STABLE /opt path - the AppImage's own copy lives under /tmp/.mount_Pen-XXXXXX, which is a fresh mount every launch and is why the `pencil` MCP server in ~/.claude.json dies with ENOENT. Caveat: its launcher runs the Electron app --no-sandbox

Lens Desktop, the Kubernetes IDE - matches the /opt/Lens you already run. NB: Lens is commercial now; it requires a sign-in and the free tier is personal-use/below a revenue threshold. If that ever bites, freelens-bin is the actively maintained free fork (NOT openlens-bin, which is stuck on 6.5.2)

Mintlify CLI (`npm i -g mint`). No package exists in any repo or the AUR, which is the ORIGINAL meaning of "-" - unlike zed and claude-code above, this one does not self-update, npm does it. Installs into ~/.npm-global, which dot_zshrc puts on PATH via NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX; never `sudo npm -g`, that writes into pacman's /usr/lib/node_modules
